title.narrative: UNICEF supported various efforts to strengthen and expand public finance for children in the country by providing evidence on how the government invests in children and adolescents, pointing out the urgent need to increase the current spending (in 2012-2023 it represented around 3.3% of the GDP, while in the countries in the region this was 5%). Specifically, UNICEF supported various costing exercises and analysis together with various programmatic areas and developed training materials for public officials at subnational level.

Extent to which social sector budgets (including social protection) have been strengthened with UNICEFs support, for greater and better investments in children, including in humanitarian and fragile contexts
